data.narrative:
Helsing is a Series D defense and security technology company founded by Gundbert Scherf, Niklas Köhler, and Torsten Reil, currently valued at $18.0B post-money with $1.6B+ raised to date. The relevant comp universe includes two public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private peers, with same-stage and sector comparables including Saronic ($9.2B), Chaos Industries ($4.5B), and Onebrief ($2.1B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.5x step-up multiplier from the Series D post-money valuation of $18.0B, implying $27.0B. Peer-median methodology examines the three same-sector, same-stage comparables, which show a median valuation of $4.5B (range: $2.1B–$9.2B). The peer median reflects meaningful dispersion across the Defense & Security Series D cohort, with Saronic valued at more than 4x Onebrief.

Triangulation of these two methods produces a valuation range of $3.8B (low) to $31.0B (high), with a median of $15.8B. The current $18.0B valuation sits above the peer-derived median but below the stage-progression ceiling, suggesting pricing near the upper quartile of comparable Series D exits in the sector. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the three-company peer set and the applicability of stage-progression multiples to a heavily capitalized defense technology company.
